huhu.pose: standing upright facing the viewer, feet slightly apart, both arms relaxed at his sides a little away from the body, tail curving up behind his right leg
huhu.expression: calm friendly smile, mouth closed, both eyes open and looking straight at the viewer

huhu.slot: PT-07 Map found (hero). North Star moment
huhu.pose: standing in three-quarter view turned to the right, holding an old folded paper map open with both paws at chest height, leaning slightly forward
huhu.expression: amazed and excited, eyes wide, small open mouth under the smile line
huhu.prop: an old cream paper map #EFE3C4, folded in thirds, plain with a few faded ink dotted lines, no text, no red X, no compass

huhu.pose: standing, body turned three-quarter to the right, one paw raised near his cheek, ears perked up, tail straight up
huhu.expression: surprised and happy at the same time, eyebrows up, small round open mouth under the smile line
huhu.accent: two short orange #FF8F45 surprise strokes above his head

huhu.slot: Reader corner (150pt). Rises from bottom edge, cropped at hips in layout
huhu.pose: standing, head tilted slightly to the right, one paw cupped behind his right ear as if listening
huhu.expression: focused and curious, eyes looking up and to the right, mouth closed

huhu.pose: sitting upright on his bottom, legs out in front, holding one bánh cam with both paws close to his mouth
huhu.expression: delighted, eyes half closed in joy, taking a small bite, small open mouth under the smile line
huhu.prop: one bánh cam: a round golden fried sesame ball #D9953B with tiny cream sesame dots, about the size of his paw. It must read as a Vietnamese sesame ball, not a coin, not a cookie

huhu.pose: sitting upright, patting his round belly with one paw, the other paw resting on the rim of a small bowl beside him
huhu.expression: content and satisfied, eyes closed in happy arcs, closed smile
huhu.prop: a small round Vietnamese ceramic bowl, cream with one blue band, piled with bánh cam sesame balls

huhu.pose: curled up lying on his side on the ground, head resting on his paws, tail wrapped around his body
huhu.expression: peacefully asleep, eyes closed in soft arcs, smile line still visible
huhu.accent: the ghost wisps are also sleepy, eyes as small closed arcs

bg.slot: C0 · Companion pick, Name, Home for new users
bg.scene: a small Vietnamese stilt house (nhà sàn) with a thatched roof on a gentle hill, banana trees and ferns around it, a woven bamboo fence, a clay water jar (chum) by the steps, one glass oil lamp hanging under the eaves
bg.mood: cosy, safe, first night of an adventure

bg.scene: a small village lane lined with tall bamboo groves, two thatched houses with woven rattan walls, a round woven basket boat (thúng chai) leaning on a fence, a conical hat (nón lá) hanging on a post, one glass oil lamp on a wooden stool by a doorway
a deep round-canopy forest with huge banana leaves and giant ferns, mossy roots, a narrow dirt path winding into the trees, one glass oil lamp resting on a flat stone
bg.mood: mysterious, playful, many eyes watching kindly

bg_layout.calm: the top 30 percent across the full width is a calm deep indigo night sky with no stars; the middle third of the width from 30 to 70 percent high is a calm dark teal leaf wall where a cream card sits
bg_layout.stage: one flat empty patch of grass or path from 6 to 36 percent of the width, top at 62 percent of the height, where a character stands
bg_layout.busy: the right 30 percent of the image between 25 and 75 percent high, plus the far left edge above the stage

bg_states.chua-sang: Edit only the light and mist, keep everything else exactly the same: the oil lamp flame is out (glass chimney empty, no amber), a soft flat layer of cool blue-grey mist covers the lower half, colours 20 percent less saturated. No blur.
bg_states.da-sang: Base render. Lamp lit, full saturation.
